# Breach notification

Owner: @compliant-org/security
Last reviewed: 2025-11-01

## Deadlines
Supervisory authority: within 72 hours of becoming aware. Affected customers and data subjects: without undue delay.

## Templates
Customer and regulator templates live in docs/security/templates/.

## Vendor incident notices
Subprocessors must notify security@compliant-app.example of any breach within 48 hours (per the DPA). Each vendor notice opens an incident.
